name: suggest
description: Clickable suggested replies under Claude's last message

mode.title: Suggest › Mode
mode.description: Claude Code's own suggestion always shows (free). auto: extra replies after every reply. smart: only when Claude asks or offers something. manual: only when you run /suggest.

click.title: Suggest › Click
click.description: send: a click sends the reply (✎ next to it puts it in the input instead). fill: a click puts it in the input, Enter to send.

maxReplies.title: Suggest › Replies
maxReplies.description: Buttons shown, Claude Code's own suggestion first. 1 keeps only that one and skips the extra model call. Leave empty for 3.

model.title: Suggest › Model
model.description: Model that writes the extra replies

effort.title: Suggest › Effort
effort.description: How hard that model thinks. Low is fastest and cheapest.

contextChars.title: Suggest › Context (characters)
contextChars.description: How much recent conversation the model reads, newest first. Leave empty for 6000.

messageChars.title: Suggest › Per-message limit (characters)
messageChars.description: Longer messages keep only their tail. Leave empty for 2500.
